results.title: HT Evening News Brief Nov 7: PM Modi’s Diwali message, IAF's historic landing in Ladakh and more
results.content: Here's a quick recap of the day's top headlines from India, the world and the field of sports and entertainment.

results.title: Dispute over parking, dog ended in ex-Tech Mahindra executive's murder in Faridabad; accused arrested
results.content: The victim had arrived in India from Singapore on November 5 to celebrate Diwali with his family and was also scheduled to attend his nephew's wedding.

results.title: Indian Army debunks ‘unsubstantiated, false’ claims of Chinese troops advancing in Arunachal Pradesh
results.content: The Indian Army accused Pakistan-sponsored social media accounts of circulating "unsubstantiated" claims of Chinese troops advancing in Arunachal Pradesh

results.title: ‘Great damage to India in 12 years’: Sonia Gandhi’s dig at govt ahead of book launch
results.content: Sonia Gandhi alleged that Congress workers and leaders "have faced persecution of all kinds".

results.title: Delhi high court permanently protects actor Amitabh Bachchan's personality rights
results.content: In its November 5 order, the court decreed the suit filed by Bachchan in 2022, after being informed that he had entered into settlements with four entities.

results.title: Delhi court orders bulletproof jackets, handcuffs for 2 accused in singer Baliyan murder over fake encounter fears
results.content: The Shamli Police arrested the two accused, Deepak and Yogesh, in connection with the murder, and they are lodged in Tihar Jail

results.title: Lights, lamps and rangolis: Foreign embassies in India take part in Diwali celebrations
results.content: Foreign embassies in India marked Diwali with parties, lamp-lighting ceremonies, rangolis and cultural performances.

results.title: Toll in Old Delhi's Chawri Bazar building collapse rises to 4 as two more bodies pulled out
results.content: One of the deceased was identified as Pankaj Sharma, a resident of Hanuman Nagar village in Bihar’s Khagaria district.

results.title: ‘We are all proud of her’: Thiruvananthapuram kin cheer Indian-origin Nithya Raman's historic win as Los Angeles mayor
results.content: Nithya Raman, 45, a member of the Los Angeles City Council representing District 4, defeated incumbent Karen Bass, 73, in the November 3 election.

results.title: IIT to Rohini: 10 most polluted areas in Delhi amid ‘very poor’ AQI on Diwali eve
results.content: An analysis by the HT Pollution Dashboard showed that 21 stations recorded 'severe' air quality, while 30 were in the 'very poor' category.

results.title: Enforcement Directorate challenges closure of money laundering case against NewsClick
results.content: The portal was probed by the Economic Offences Wing of the Delhi police on allegations of receiving foreign funding.

results.title: Ex-CJI Gavai to head panel vetting forest rights claims in Tamil Nadu
results.content: The Supreme Court on Friday appointed former Chief Justice of India (CJI) Bhushan R Gavai to head a special committee that will scrutinise orders passed by authorities in Tamil Nadu under the Forest Rights Act, 2006 (FRA), even as it came down hard on the state government for its prolonged failure to initiate the statutory process to identify and adjudicate the claims of forest dwellers in the ecologically sensitive Agasthyamalai landscape

results.title: SC rejects bail plea of doctor accused of prescribing cough syrup linked to 26 child deaths
results.content: New Delhi: The Supreme Court on Friday refused to grant bail to paediatrician Praveen Soni, who was arrested in October 2025 for allegedly continuing to prescribe Coldrif cough syrup linked to the deaths of 26 children in Madhya Pradesh, observing that the case was too serious to warrant his release at this stage

results.title: India, EU conclude negotiations over key scientific cooperation programme
results.content: Once the agreement is signed and procedures are completed by both sides, Indian organisations will be able to receive funding directly from Horizon Europe.

results.title: CJP protest LIVE: Abhijeet Dipke joins anti-SIR protest in Kochi, says ‘Gyanesh Kumar must go’
results.content: CJP protest LIVE: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke arrived in Kochi to attend the anti-SIR protest, saying that the fight against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar will continue until India gets an independent and impartial election system.

results.title: Pakistan says willing to issue visa to Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann for visit
results.content: Pakistan Foreign Office said it would consider a visa for Bhagwant Mann if he wishes to visit, adding whether India allows him to travel is a separate matter.

results.title: EC gives fresh chance to voters excluded from draft SIR rolls in Delhi, Maharashtra, 5 other states
results.content: The EC has directed seven states to help electors marked absent, shifted, dead or duplicate submit fresh forms and seek inclusion in final rolls.

results.title: HT Evening News Brief November 6: Grap 3 imposed in Delhi, FIR on Chawri Bazar collapse reveals ignored warnings
results.content: Authorities tightened pollution controls as Delhi’s air quality neared the severe mark.

results.title: India, EU conclude negotiations for association with Horizon Europe research programme
results.content: India’s association with the EU’s €93.5-billion Horizon Europe programme will open up research funding and collaboration opportunities.

results.title: Delhi Metro revises timings on Diwali; services to start 1 hour early on 3 lines, last train at 10pm
results.content: In a post on X, the DMRC announced that metro services on the Pink, Magenta and Grey lines, which usually begin at 7 am on Sundays, will commence at 6 am.

results.title: Fire breaks out at South Delhi Kia showroom; several injured
results.content: The fire has been brought under control, but a search operation is under way inside the showroom to check whether anyone is still trapped.

results.title: The fiery heat of the Deccan is all grit and no garden
results.content: Today in India it has become fashionable to talk about gluten-free food as a way to overcome the diabetes that is rampant in our country.

results.title: Grap 3 curbs implemented in Delhi-NCR as air quality remains in ‘very poor’ category
results.content: The Air Quality Index (AQI) entered ‘severe’ category in parts of Delhi on Friday.

results.title: Notices purportedly issued at police’s behest for takedown of IFF, SFLC accounts fake, X tells HC
results.content: X cited an internal investigation and said it showed that the notices had not been issued by the Delhi Police

results.title: Reservation-category Indian faculty match general category peers in teaching, research despite fewer PhDs: Study
results.content: The study found that students taught by reservation-category faculty performed marginally better in their immediate course examinations.

results.title: Telecom regulator recommends new licence to let satellite firms rent out networks to telcos
results.content: If DoT accepts the recommendations, global satellite firms such as Starlink and Eutelsat OneWeb could enter India purely as network providers.

results.title: Rohini, RK Puram, Vivek Vihar among 10 most polluted areas in Delhi-NCR
results.content: An analysis of the data by HT Pollution Dashboard showed that 31 monitoring stations recorded 'severe' air quality, while 28 were in the 'very poor' category.
